scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the final five marketing originals. No live marketing operations or execution outcomes.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the five originals were read. Scoring criteria, platform specs, snippets, recipe builders, marketing references, collector implementations and actual datasets and licenses need separate review. Source claims and example benchmarks are not independently validated facts or new study results.

sources.workflow: Identify the actual mobile-store listing, collect available live text and visual evidence, account for the original's brand-maturity rules, apply its referenced weighted rubric and deliver a specific prioritized audit with missing evidence disclosed.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real selected listing, product context, platform and date, actual screenshot or browser evidence and reviewed scoring criteria and platform references are required. Competitor comparison additionally needs actual comparable listings. Paid ranking and search-volume data are separate optional evidence, not automatically available from scraped text; hidden store-console fields cannot be observed in a public listing.
sources.offline_assessment: An explicitly scoped audit of unchanged public captured listing fields and images may be offline after rubric and input-license review. The default container can count text and compute weighted scores but cannot fetch current listings or interpret images as a deterministic objective. A text-only draft does not certify visual quality, actual ranking or improved conversion.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify field provenance and missingness, exact text counts versus byte limits, weighted-score arithmetic, consistent maturity adjustments and concrete recommendations. Visual and semantic judgments require a predeclared rubric and independent assessment. Do not infer hidden keywords from visible fields or claim empirical uplift from the source's unverified benchmarks.

sources.workflow: Establish the actual confirmed conversion, destination and sending infrastructure, diagnose existing tracking before changing it, select an appropriate native or browser or server path and separately verify firing and destination receipt without conflating them with attribution.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual app or page code and conversion semantics, all existing browser and server senders, consent configuration and the selected destination contract are required. Real platform receipt needs authorized destination access and an approved test environment. Snippets, recipe generator, event map and platform references require separate review; the original explicitly rejects adding a sender without checking duplicates.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected code change, recipe-file transformation or event deduplication check may be offline with real public artifacts and an independent acceptance contract. The default container cannot prove a browser tag or actual destination arrival. No test should inject events into a live advertising account, and a fabricated click identifier cannot establish real attribution.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently exercise success versus failed attempts, duplicate and refresh guards, correct values and currencies, consent and preserved existing senders. Separate built, installed, firing, arrived and attributed endpoints, and distinguish observed from reported or inferred evidence. Static page absence cannot prove absent server-side tracking, and unknown access must not be scored as a tracking failure.

sources.workflow: Determine whether a real target page has an authority rather than content gap, identify useful existing assets and appropriate prospects, prepare approved outreach and measure actual placements, mentions and subsequent outcomes separately.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual target pages and query goals, public competitor and page-level link evidence, real assets and the selected tactic and policy references are required. Tool or account access depends on the chosen data source. Contact and outreach claims need actual permission and evidence; source policy dates and vendor recommendations are not verified merely by this read.
sources.offline_assessment: A provenance-preserving analysis of a real public backlink export or an outreach draft can be offline after reviewing schema, license and independent acceptance rules. Drafting a plan is not earning a placement, and an isolated Python task cannot establish fresh rankings or actual third-party citations. Human editorial decisions and future outcomes must not be mocked as successes.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check page-level rather than only domain-level comparisons, real prospect relevance and evidence, all target-page mappings and qualified paid-link attributes. For any measured outcome require actual dated placement or mention evidence and separate it from subsequent rankings, referral conversion or model visibility. A plausible list or scheduled outreach is not an earned link.

sources.workflow: Identify the real offer and business type, diagnose its current value levers and offer components, select one justified change and draft that component without fabricating proof, urgency, value or guarantees.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual product or service context, current deliverables, price and payment terms, fulfillment capacity, evidence and genuine deadline or guarantee constraints are required. The selected business-type, value, anatomy and guarantee references need separate review. No external service or paid account is inherently required to produce a local draft, but semantic quality and business impact require independent evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A clearly scoped offer-document revision can be offline with real public source material, a fixed brief and a reviewed rubric. The default runtime can check specified structure and exact constraints, not determine commercial persuasiveness or measure future conversion. The original's suggested lift ranges are claims to scrutinize, not promised or observed outcomes.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the revision with actual fulfillment and proof, explicit price and conditions, genuine scarcity and the chosen single-component scope. Use independently specified content and honesty checks plus a human rubric for qualitative quality. Do not count section presence, an invented leverage score or unsupported predicted uplift as a better-performing real offer.

sources.workflow: Build a dated, provenance-preserving timeline of a real company's traffic and marketing moves, compare like-for-like evidence and identify testable plays while preserving the distinction between timing, correlation and causation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual selected company, mode, time window, approved data scope and costs, real consistently sourced traffic and dated move artifacts and applicable industry references are required. Collector implementation, schemas and data licenses need review. The full collection flow can involve networks and authorized accounts or purchases, none supplied by the default sandbox or permitted by prerequisite review.
sources.offline_assessment: Recomputing a timeline, clustered growth lift or rank correlations from real unchanged public exports can be offline after reviewing actual scripts and numeric definitions. That is a scoped data-analysis task, not live competitor collection or causal discovery. No sign-up, staff contact, purchase, identity use, account access or external model request is authorized here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact dates, one vendor per traffic curve, move provenance, cluster formation, pre/post windows, missing values, minimum sample sizes and within-channel ranks independently. Compare estimates with the same vendor's estimates and retain observed, reported and inferred labels. Test changing and empty inputs, avoid causation claims from correlated timing and require actual visual evidence for image-based claims.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
